title.narrative: Innovative Agriculture Training and Learning Camp (AGRI CAMP) Program

description.narrative: USAID financed AGRI CAMP Program aims to promote the development of innovative agriculture in Armenia by fostering triangular partnership between industry sector, students, young professionals and agripreneurs through hands-on and innovative agricultural training and skills building.
